note: Committed vectors for a backup key slot, for implementations to check their slots against. v1 = a sealed_x25519_v1 slot (ADR-029): info identity-agent-backup-seal-shared-v1, no AAD. v2 = a sealed_x25519_v2 slot (ADR-029, amendment): info identity-agent-backup-seal-shared-v2, AAD = the 16-byte file id. Slot = eph_pub(32)|nonce(12)|AES-256-GCM(wrapped bek + tag)(48); KEK = HKDF-SHA256(X25519(eph,recip), salt=eph_pub|recip_pub, 32). Every value hex.
